scope: Prerequisite routes and missing local suppliers for the numerical-statistics research dossier.

provides: Chebyshev interpolation stability/error relation if its Lebesgue-constant proof is locally supplied.
A clean upstream input for MSF-26 spline interpolation and numerical quadrature.
fences: Do not turn polynomial density into a claim that arbitrary interpolation nodes converge.
MSF-26 retains the separate natural-cubic and Sobolev spline-rate proofs.

provides: Positive-weight Gaussian quadrature exactness and remainder.
fences: BCS-23 consumes quadrature error but owns Laplace approximation error.
Adaptive error estimators do not supply certified error bounds without an additional remainder/stability theorem.

page_prerequisite_route.proposed_status: generic numerical integration provider; BCS statistical consumers
requires: product-space integration and Fubini/Tonelli where used
a definition of star discrepancy and anchored Hardy-Krause variation
provides: IID MC unbiasedness, variance and RMSE.
Deterministic Koksma-Hlawka and RQMC marginal-unbiasedness contracts.
Nested-scramble variance contract only after a local proof is supplied.
fences: BCS-56/57 own plan organization and statistical interpretation of randomized replicates.
Replicate variance estimates do not become data-sampling or model-bias estimates.

requires: P-NUM-SDE-01/02 only for conditional Euler examples
provides: Giles abstract MLMC cost theorem under explicit alpha/beta/work assumptions.
fences: Do not infer SDE convergence from the abstract theorem.
BCS-55 owns its statistical error-budget interpretation.
Adaptive level and bias stopping remain heuristic without a separate guarantee.

provides: P-NUM-SDE-01 local finite-L2 route: adapted L2 initial state independent of future Brownian increments; Borel-time, globally Lipschitz/linear-growth state coefficients with the stated 1/2-Hölder time modulus; derive moment bounds and strong error locally.
P-NUM-SDE-02 exact Higham-Mao-Stuart strong theorem and the separately stated weak-order local proof design.
fences: The H-M-S all-moment autonomous theorem and finite-L2 time-dependent local route are distinct contracts.
Weak regularity of the backward Kolmogorov solution must be separately proved.
No learned-score/model error is covered by a numerical SDE convergence theorem.
The plan states the P-NUM-SDE-01 time modulus qualitatively; its norm and constants must be made explicit before authoring a theorem.

Published Itô-integral and multidimensional Itô suppliers explicitly carry AC and standing hypothesis (H) from def-elementary-predictable-brownian-integrand; preserve these inherited premises or prove an alternate interface.

provides: SME-02/04 least-squares and Fisher-scoring numerical input.
fences: Reuse published algebraic least-squares, QR, condition and regularization items; no parallel statistical inverse theory.
No global optimizer result for nonconvex likelihoods.

supplier_layers.role: Polynomial uniqueness/remainder prerequisites and uniform polynomial approximation.
Candidate stable research slugs; all listed theorem results are established mathematics with local proof obligations, not open problems.

supplier_layers.status: source proof plus local proof designs
supplier_layers.role: MLMC abstract result is fully proved in Giles. Strong EM has two noninterchangeable proof routes. Weak EM is a local design whose regularity and remainder obligations are explicit.
Conditioning, exact least squares, QR, floating-point and regularization contracts; no duplicate numerical inverse chapter.

missing_supplier_designs.hypotheses: Distinct real nodes x_0,...,x_n; f in C^(n+1)[a,b].
proof_route: Use the interpolating polynomial and an auxiliary multiple of the node product.
Apply repeated Rolle to obtain the pointwise derivative remainder.

missing_supplier_designs.hypotheses: Positive measure on [a,b], moments through degree 2m-1, positive-definite polynomial inner product through degree m; f in C^(2m) for the remainder.
proof_route: Construct monic orthogonal p_m by Gram-Schmidt.
Prove m simple interior roots by a sign-change argument.
Use q=p_m r+s division for exactness and ell_i^2 for weight positivity.
Use Hermite double-node interpolation and Rolle for the error.
intermediates: Lagrange weights and the Gaussian remainder identity.

missing_supplier_designs.hypotheses: Points in [0,1]^d and finite anchored Hardy-Krause variation in the source's convention.
proof_route: Prove the one-dimensional Stieltjes/summation-by-parts discrepancy bound.
Use anchored mixed-variation decomposition to reduce to box indicators.
Bound each box discrepancy by star discrepancy.
guardrails: Do not call the product a computable empirical error bar when discrepancy or variation is unavailable.

missing_supplier_designs.hypotheses: Nested uniform scramble of a (0,m,d)-net, b>=max(d,2), n=b^m, f in L^2.
proof_route: Prove the scramble ANOVA variance decomposition.
Bound component covariance via elementary interval occupancy.
Sum the component bounds to obtain factor (b/(b-1))^min(m,d-1).
missing_supplier_designs.source_limit: Owen Ch. 17 Theorem 17.3 cites Owen (1997a) instead of proving it; do not broaden to arbitrary randomizations.

missing_supplier_designs.hypotheses: Bounded payoff; backward u in C^2 time/C^4 space with derivatives bounded by C(1+|x|^q); uniform exact/Euler moments p>=2q+8.
proof_route: Conditional one-step Gaussian Taylor expansion and cubic odd-moment cancellation.
missing_supplier_designs.missing_intermediate: A theorem deriving the stated backward-solution regularity from coefficient/payoff smoothness, if such a route is claimed.
missing_supplier_designs.source_limit: Särkkä-Solin and Higham expositions do not prove weak order one under a matching explicit contract.

missing_supplier_designs.hypotheses: A posteriori remainder/defect bound, stability propagation, integrand/method regularity, and controlled arithmetic.
proof_route: Bound each accepted panel's true defect.
Propagate panel defects through the integral or ODE stability operator.
missing_supplier_designs.source_limit: Adaptive estimators as presented in FNC are heuristic. This is not a mathematical open problem; omit a certificate theorem unless these premises are supplied.

dependency_fences: BCS-54 remains the statistical/inferential error ledger owner; this dossier supplies only component definitions and pathwise composition.
BCS-23 consumes deterministic quadrature bounds but owns Laplace approximation error.
BCS-25/56/57 consume generic numerical contracts and retain inferential calibration.
BCS-55 consumes MLMC cost plus separately qualified SDE rates; no inference claim belongs in the abstract theorem.
P-NUM-SDE-01 finite-L2 and H-M-S all-moment strong contracts are separate; weak order is another separate proof.
Learned-score/model bias does not disappear under numerical refinement and is not covered by solver convergence.
All missing theorem suppliers above concern established mathematics. Only the optional star-discrepancy order question is genuinely open.

open_problem_candidate.claim: For fixed d>=3, determine the exact asymptotic order of the minimum star discrepancy over n-point subsets of [0,1]^d.
open_problem_candidate.boundary: Lower and upper bounds do not match; supply no proof and use the new op- kind only if an open-problem item is deliberately included.
open_problem_candidate.source: Owen, Practical QMC, Ch. 15 discrepancy discussion and cited Roth lower bound.
